this function rounds a number to the nearest number of digits specified
```{r}
round(3.14159, digits = 2)
```
the seq function generates a sequence of numbers where 'from' is the start, 'to' i the end, and 'by' is the increment.
```{r}
seq(1, 10, 2)
```
here we have counted from 1 to 10 by 2 (and so don't reach 10)

rep can be used to repeat a (value, times)
```{r}
rep(2, 5)
```

In R variable names can't start with a number. Variables can assume three types, those being numeric, character and logical.
```{r}
x <- 1.74
y <- "hello"
z <- TRUE
print(paste(x, y, z))
print(class(x))
print(class(y))
print(class(z))
```

cell_id_1 <- "C1"
